### Little Red — G4 (*Friendship is Magic*)

**Who she is.** Little Red is the fan-used name for a small, white Earth-pony schoolfoal with a raspberry-pink mane and tail, large purple glasses, and a pink-and-purple **abacus cutie mark**. She is memorable as one of the excited children crowding around the Cutie Mark Crusaders in **“Twilight Time”** (season 4, episode 15). [FiM Color Guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/534-Little-Red)

**Names and continuity.** “Little Red” was already used in punzil504's March 2014 cast illustration; I found no confirmation that it is her official TV name. Gameloft's licensed game instead calls her **Nearsighted Schoolpony**, and its future-aged version **Nearsighted Future Ponyville Citizen**. These are game labels, not a disguise or a separate secret identity. Although commonly described as a filly, the [FiM wiki's foal catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals) reports that director Jim Miller said the animation character's gender was unspecified in 2014; the game uses she/her.

**Speech and appearances.** She individually shouts **“Twilight Time!”** before the other foals chant; that line is identified in the [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Twilight_Time). No reliably attributable English voice actor was verified. Subsequent background sightings include **“Crusaders of the Lost Mark,” “The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows,” “28 Pranks Later,” “A Flurry of Emotions,” “Fame and Misfortune,” “Yakity-Sax,”** and a future-aged appearance in **“The Last Problem.”** Similar-looking ponies in IDW comics are not confirmed to be the same individual.
